title: Chapter 458 The Supreme Demon Lord
content:
Chapter 458 The Supreme Demon Lord

Liu Han felt a little uneasy when he heard Wang Shuo's threat, although only the strongest king had the strength to smash the tombstone.

But he was afraid of the worst. If his tombstone was really smashed by this kid, he would really lose his life.

He would slowly forget his name and his skills, and his strength would slowly decline. His final fate would be to be swallowed by other ghosts.

"Wait a minute, let's talk it over."

Liu Han's voice came from the grave.

"The key I'm talking about doesn't exist, or I am the key myself."

"As long as you defeat 100 ghosts, you can go to Youquan Mountain, where there is a bath that can improve your cultivation and help you reach the strongest king realm."

Wang Shuo was thoughtful.

"What will happen if I am killed by you?"

"Of course you will become my colleague. For every 10 humans killed, I can also get the qualification to enter Youquan Mountain once..."

After Wang Shuo basically understood the situation, he asked again: "Where are the ghosts?"

"Ghosts are everywhere, but it counts only if you kill those with tombstones."

Wang Shuo looked around. There were low hills in the distance. It was gray under the sky and he couldn't see very far.

Within the field of vision, Wang Shuo quickly locked a direction.

There seemed to be several tombstones there.

Wang Shuo didn't dare to be careless. Logically speaking, a white tombstone corresponds to a master of the high-level general level.

If several tombstones are triggered at the same time, he will have to deal with several people at the same time.

Wang Shuo stood in the distance and observed for a long time, but he didn't go over in the end.

Because he found that one of the names engraved on the tombstone was "Extreme Demon Lord - Sun Xiaoyun".

This Extreme Demon Lord scared Wang Shuo.

As a last resort, Wang Shuo had to continue looking for the lone tombstone.

After walking for a while, Wang Shuo finally found a lonely ghost.

This ghost was disheveled and had only the strength of a junior general. Wang Shuo did not hesitate and shot it with a shot, killing it instantly.

But there was no prompt. Sure enough, it was inexperienced to kill such a monster.

Wang Shuo walked a long way and felt a little hungry and thirsty. He took out the food and started eating.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo felt his neck tighten, as if he was pinched by something.

Wang Shuo tried his best to twist his neck to see what was behind him.

But the range of his neck was too small to be seen at all.

He could only see a black arm on his neck.

Wang Shuo's face was flushed, and he resisted the difficulty in breathing and stabbed back with a spear.

The ghost felt pain and immediately let go of Wang Shuo's neck.

Wang Shuo turned around and looked, and the ghost slowly became transparent.

Wang Shuo was a little scared. Why didn't he notice that there was a ghost approaching just now?

Considering the current situation, this ghost should be able to become invisible.

Wang Shuo became alert. This was too creepy.

Wang Shuo stared at the surroundings nervously. He was sure that the ghost had not gone far.

After looking around, he still did not find any tombstones.

This ghost that could become invisible should not be too high in level.

After waiting for a long time, Wang Shuo lost some patience.

He wanted to escape from this place.

So, he immediately turned around and ran in one direction for dozens of miles.

He patted his chest and breathed a sigh of relief.

At this time, he realized that he seemed to have broken into a mass grave.

There were tombstones of all sizes around.

Sure enough, ghosts woke up from the tombstones.

"Hehe, finally there is fresh blood food, delivered to the door."
